name: Jurisdiction of Saint-Emilion
description: Saint-Émilion is a medieval hilltop town in the Gironde, near Bordeaux in southwestern France, ringed by vineyards that have been tended since Roman times. Its steep, narrow streets are lined with Romanesque churches and ruins. Pilgrims heading to Santiago de Compostela once passed through, and the town received special "jurisdiction" status under English rule in the 12th century. Today, wine still shapes the entire landscape.
